g.text: Cut trace to remove power LED
Cut trace to isolate shield from GND
Cut trace to remove charge LED
Cut traces to remove I2C pullup resistors
Connect JP1 jumper to A0 side to reroute reset pin. Useful when using as a peripheral board
Cut D3_ISO trace to isolate PD03 if JP1 is moved to A0 side
Cut trace to force debugger into low power mode
Charge current: I_CHG = 1000 / R_PROG R_PROG=2k : I_CHG=500mA R_PROG=10k: I_CHG=100mA
The following pins are connected for escape routing only: PA15, PB15, PC0, PD2, PE2, PE3, PE9, PF4
Cut and resolder jumper to change charge current
